top5.title: Meta Seeks to Raise Up to $25 Billion in Debt to Fund AI
top5.description: Meta is seeking to raise up to $25 billion in the debt markets as its artificial intelligence spending increases.
top5.why: Meta’s plan to raise up to $25 billion in debt underscores the enormous financing requirements of its AI buildout and could influence investor assessments of Big Tech capital spending.

top5.title: Voters oppose new AI infrastructure in their region
top5.description: According to an NBC News exit poll, a majority of voters say AI and data centers played an important role in their vote. They also say they oppose new AI infrastructure in their community.
top5.why: Voter opposition to new AI infrastructure signals a growing political and regulatory constraint on the data-center expansion needed to sustain the AI boom.

top5.title: Nvidia Will Be Able to Fulfill Only 1% of Chinese GPU Orders
top5.description: Over the coming months, Nvidia will deliver only about 1% of the RTX Pro 5500 GPUs ordered by Chinese companies such as ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent. Demand reportedly amounts to about $70 billion, far exceeding current production capacity.
top5.why: Nvidia’s ability to fulfill only about 1% of Chinese demand highlights severe GPU supply constraints and the continuing impact of export controls on the AI market.

top5.title: Apple Opens Siri’s AI to All Apps
top5.description: Apple now allows app developers to integrate their content and actions with Siri through a developer preview. Integrations could include checking a delivery, booking a service, or combining multiple actions.
top5.why: Apple’s decision to let developers connect apps and actions to Siri could turn Apple Intelligence into a broader platform and intensify competition among AI assistants.

top5.title: OpenAI plans to acquire code-hosting startup Pierre
top5.description: OpenAI has agreed to acquire Pierre Computer, the startup that already hosts Codex’s code repositories. The deal brings OpenAI closer to GitHub’s territory.
top5.why: OpenAI’s planned acquisition of code-hosting startup Pierre would extend Codex deeper into the software-development stack and increase pressure on GitHub.
